description: window.dropFiles(files) drops files on the composer: it dispatches a "drop" DragEvent carrying a text/plain File for each [name, content] pair on ".message-input-container"; call it in an eval, e.g. window.dropFiles([["a.txt", "some content"]]). Dropping several files creates an attachment for each. 1. Navigate to /new and wait for the message input (data-testid "message-input") to be visible. 2. Drop three files at once, in one call: "drop-0.txt" containing "content 0", "drop-1.txt" containing "content 1" and "drop-2.txt" containing "content 2". 3. There should be exactly three attachment chips (".message-attachment").
